title: Document review
subtitle: Nothing is saved to the record until you confirm the fields

limits.person_name: Names may be incomplete or split across lines. Compare the spelling with the source.
limits.identity_number: Identity numbers can contain misread digits. Open the source and compare every digit.
limits.date: Dates can have ambiguous order or unclear years. Compare the full date with the source.
limits.money: Amounts can have unclear separators or currency. Compare the amount and currency with the source.
limits.unit_code: Unit codes can contain similar letters and digits. Compare the complete code with the source.
limits.plot_code: Plot codes can contain similar letters and digits. Compare the complete code with the source.
limits.nationality: Nationality wording can be incomplete. Use only the text present on this document.
limits.text: Text may be incomplete or misread. Empty fields must remain empty unless the document supplies a value.
